No AI image generators were used for the game's visuals. The clover, trees, and ground were modeled and textured in the 3D software Blender from the developer's own photos of the real thing, then assembled into a forest in Unity. The concept, the photography, and the decisions about how the game looks were all the developer's own.
Made with help from AI
• The game's code and the Blender scripts that build the shapes and textures. The developer checked the finished visuals side by side with the photos of the real thing.
• The text in the game and on the store page, and its translation from Japanese into 10 languages, including English. The translations were made by AI and checked by a different AI. No native speaker has reviewed them, so if you spot a mistranslation, please report it through the support contact.

We use about 15 seconds of AI footage in our trailer. All assets in the game are human authored.
We also use a local, small and offline LLM (meaning: no data ever leaves your computer, and it does not cause significant performance drops) as a Director that controls: enemy spawn and frequency of challenges, essentially choosing when to press with difficulty and when to hold the challenge based on parameters such as player frustration, boredom and an emergence metric.
This mechanic does not generate any text, narrative or story: it is just a mechanic that controls game balance to ensure the best challenge. And you can turn it off on the settings menu, if you want.

- Story text: scene descriptions, character dialogue, action outcomes, world-building entries

Default experience: The game includes a built-in relay service (enabled by default, no setup required). Players can launch and play immediately. All AI requests are routed through the developer's own server, which applies keyword filtering and progressive moderation on both input and output before forwarding to the AI model. Every player receives a free daily quota.
Monetization: One-time DLC purchases are available through Steam for additional turns beyond the free daily quota. These are single purchases, not subscriptions, priced $1–$10. DLC revenue covers the developer's costs.
Content guardrails: In Relay Mode, all requests pass through server-side multi-layer moderation — keyword filtering (red-line terms blocked immediately; yellow-line terms accumulate toward escalation), bidirectional input/output checks, and progressive restrictions for repeat violations.

No Artist Credited is a virtual gallery experience and an experiment in the capabilities and limitations of AI tools. The entire gallery was designed and constructed using instructions, themes, and art generated by one of three AI tools.

At Lovely Bytes, we're not just developers, we're passionate gamers like you. And because we understand the gamer's perspective, we firmly believe that the heart of a truly great game lies in the emotional depth and authenticity that only human creativity can provide.
In the development of UNHEIM, artificial intelligence plays a supporting role to accelerate our production, and is used mindfully to help us with certain time-consuming tasks, such as visual brainstorming, or speeding up the process of creating some of the textures. Additionally, AI bravely tackles the Herculean task of turning our chaotic creative thoughts and wild brainstorming scribbles into something resembling coherent, actionable documents.
Our approach to AI is to use it as a tool to augment our skills and capabilities, not to substitute the craft elements that are crucial for creating a deeply engaging and memorable game experience.
Now go and have fun getting scared to death, knowing that what you experience is the result of a mindful blend of assistive technology and traditional craftsmanship.

Should you have any concerns about these methods, please feel free to experience the game according to your own preferences. Thank you for your understanding and consideration.
Some of the images,and music in the game are generated by AI.
We only use parts of AI-generated voice-overs – the voice samples come from recordings of our developers working on the game.

Some AI tools were used to help with early ideation in the development process. AI tools were also used to assist in up-rezzing our portraits and adding facial animations. Final assets were all painted by artists. We have not replaced any developers with AI and believe that talented people lie at the heart of exciting games.

AI is used to create keyart, headers and some instore assets.

We want to emphasize that both human-art and AI-generated content are used in the event illustrations. At the time of writing this (pre-beta), some of the illustrations in the game are still early experiments and, as such, treated as placeholders. As artists, we fully understand that AI-generated imagery is a controversial topic at the moment. We felt that by using generated art, in addition to our own art, we could create a much more vivid and immersive experience for the player. We are fully open to discussing this further and elaborating on our approach.
